q-93094.name: Question 1
q-93094.worked_solution:
To find the root of $f(x),$  we must solve $f(x)=0:$

$$
\sqrt[4]{5x+16}-3=0
$$

We solve this equation by making $x$ the subject, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[4]{5x+16}-3 & =0 \\ \sqrt[4]{5x+16} & =3 \\ (\sqrt[4]{5x+16})^{4} & ={3}^{4} \\ 5x+16 & =81 \\ 5x & =65 \\ x & =13\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we must check the answer by substituting it back into the initial equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[4]{5\cdot 13+16}-3 & =0 \\ \sqrt[4]{81}-3 & =0 \\ 0 & =0\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the root of $f(x)$ is $x=13.$

q-102416.name: Question 2
q-102416.worked_solution:
To find the root of $f(x),$  we must solve $f(x)=0:$

$$
\sqrt[7]{3x+13}-1=0
$$

We solve this equation by making $x$ the subject, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[7]{3x+13}-1 & =0 \\ \sqrt[7]{3x+13} & =1 \\ (\sqrt[7]{3x+13})^{7} & ={1}^{7} \\ 3x+13 & =1 \\ 3x & =-12 \\ x & =-4\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the root of $f(x)$ is $x=-4.$

q-102542.name: Question 3
q-102542.worked_solution:
To find the root of $f(x),$  we must solve $f(x)=0:$

$$
-3\sqrt[7]{8x+11}+3=0
$$

We solve this equation by making $x$ the subject, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}-3\sqrt[7]{8x+11}+3 & =0 \\ -3\sqrt[7]{8x+11} & =-3 \\ \sqrt[7]{8x+11} & =1 \\ (\sqrt[7]{8x+11})^{7} & ={1}^{7} \\ 8x+11 & =1 \\ 8x & =-10 \\ x & =-\frac{5}{4}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the root of $f(x)$ is $x=-\frac{5}{4}.$
